title: Carried by the Father
story:
A father and his young son were hiking through a forest trail.

The boy eagerly walked beside his father at first.

As the path became steeper and rockier, his little legs grew tired.

Finally, he stopped and whispered,

“Dad, I can't go any farther.”

Without hesitation, his father smiled, lifted him onto his shoulders, and continued the journey.

The boy no longer worried about the rough path.

He laughed as he looked at the beautiful scenery from above.

He knew he was safe because his father was carrying him.

Life sometimes leads us through difficult and exhausting paths.

There are moments when our own strength is not enough.

Yet God is like a loving Father who carries His children.

He does not abandon us when we grow weary.

He faithfully bears us through every trial until we reach the place He has prepared for us.
life_lesson: God lovingly carries His children through life's difficult journeys. When your strength fails, His strength is always enough.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for carrying me when I become weary.

Help me to trust You instead of depending only on my own strength.

Remind me that You never leave me behind.

Carry me through every challenge until I safely reach the purpose You have for my life.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Can you remember a time when God carried you through a difficult season?

What burden do you need to place into His hands today?

How can you trust His strength instead of your own?
verse: There you saw how the Lord your God carried you, as a father carries his son, all the way you went until you reached this place.
